source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 3: book page 295 (instruction for Q1-Q5). The book prints no answers for Unit 11.

blocks.prompt: 3 Find the velocity, acceleration, speed, and direction of motion of the particle with position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \cos t\,\hat{i} + \sin t\,\hat{j} + 2t\,\hat{k}\) at \(t = \pi\). Interpret the results by describing the particle's motion at that instant, including how fast and in what direction it is moving, whether it is speeding up or slowing down, and how its path is curving.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh 3D wala sawal hai, lekin tareeqa wohi 2D wala hai, bas ek teesra component \(\hat{k}\) zyada hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \cos t\,\hat{i} + \sin t\,\hat{j} + 2t\,\hat{k}\) aur \(t = \pi\).
Find kya karna hai? Velocity, acceleration, speed, direction aur harkat ka bayan.
Rule: har component alag differentiate; \(\sin\pi = 0\), \(\cos\pi = -1\).
Plan: yeh bilkul topic ke Example 9 (drone) jaisa hai, is liye wahi qadam aur wahi tashreeh.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \cos t\,\hat{i} + \sin t\,\hat{j} + 2t\,\hat{k}\), \(t = \pi\).
Maloom karna: velocity, acceleration, speed, direction of motion aur tashreeh.
Tareeqa: har component ko ek dafa differentiate kar ke \(\mathbf{v}(t)\), dobara kar ke \(\mathbf{a}(t)\), phir \(t = \pi\) rakhna. Speed \(= |\mathbf{v}|\) aur direction \(= \frac{\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{v}|}\). Tashreeh (interpretation) ke liye: \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}\) ka sign batata hai ke particle tez ho raha hai ya dheema, aur \(\mathbf{a}\) ka jo hissa \(\mathbf{v}\) ke aar paar hai woh batata hai ke path kis taraf mur raha hai.

Velocity
\[\mathbf{v}(t) = -\sin t\,\hat{i} + \cos t\,\hat{j} + 2\,\hat{k}\]
\[\mathbf{v}(\pi) = -\sin\pi\,\hat{i} + \cos\pi\,\hat{j} + 2\,\hat{k}\]
\[= 0\,\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 2\,\hat{k}\]
Kyun: \(\cos t\) ka derivative \(-\sin t\), \(\sin t\) ka \(\cos t\), aur \(2t\) ka 2. Phir \(\sin\pi = 0\) aur \(\cos\pi = -1\) rakha.
Dhyan dein: \(\cos\pi = -1\) hai, \(+1\) nahin; yahan sign ki ghalti poora jawab bigaar deti hai.

Acceleration
\[\mathbf{a}(t) = -\cos t\,\hat{i} - \sin t\,\hat{j} + 0\,\hat{k}\]
\[\mathbf{a}(\pi) = \hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j} + 0\,\hat{k}\]
Kyun: \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) ko dobara differentiate kiya; constant 2 ka derivative zero. \(-\cos\pi = -(-1) = 1\).

Speed
\[|\mathbf{v}(t)| = \sqrt{\sin^{2}t + \cos^{2}t + 4}\]
\[= \sqrt{1 + 4} = \sqrt{5}\]
\[|\mathbf{v}(\pi)| = \sqrt{5} \approx 2.24\]
Kyun: \(\sin^{2}t + \cos^{2}t = 1\) wali identity se \(t\) ghaib ho gaya, yani speed har lamhe \(\sqrt{5}\) hai.

Direction of motion
\[\hat{\mathbf{v}}(\pi) = \dfrac{0\,\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 2\,\hat{k}}{\sqrt{5}}\]
\[= 0\,\hat{i} - \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\hat{j} + \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\hat{k}\]
Kyun: velocity ko speed \(\sqrt{5}\) se divide kiya taake lambai 1 ho jaye.

Tashreeh (interpretation)
Position: \(\mathbf{r}(\pi) = -\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j} + 2\pi\,\hat{k}\), yani point \((-1, 0, 2\pi)\). Particle \(\sqrt{5} \approx 2.24\) units per second se chal raha hai: \(x\)-direction mein koi harkat nahin, negative \(y\)-direction mein ja raha hai aur saath 2 units per second se upar (positive \(z\)) charh raha hai.
\[\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = (0)(1) + (-1)(0)\]
\[\quad + (2)(0) = 0\]
Aam \(t\) ke liye bhi \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = \sin t\cos t - \sin t\cos t + 0 = 0\), yani particle kabhi tez ya dheema nahin hota; speed hamesha \(\sqrt{5}\).
\(\mathbf{a} = \hat{i}\) ufuqi (horizontal) hai aur \((-1, 0, 2\pi)\) se seedha \(z\)-axis ki taraf ishara karta hai. Aur \(x^{2} + y^{2} = \cos^{2}t + \sin^{2}t = 1\), is liye path 1 radius ka helix (spring jaisa chakkardar raasta) hai jo \(z\)-axis ke gird lipta hua hai. Particle upar charhte hue axis ke gird ghoomta rehta hai, jaise seerhiyon wali gol (spiral) seerhi par chalna.
Kyun: bilkul Example 9 (drone) wali soch.

Khulasa
Ek nazar mein: particle point \((-1, 0, 2\pi)\) par hai, \(\sqrt{5}\) units per second ki constant speed se negative \(y\) ki taraf aur upar ja raha hai, aur acceleration use \(z\)-axis ki taraf mor raha hai taake woh helix par rahe. Yahan farq samajhna zaroori hai: Questions 1 aur 2 mein \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = 0\) sirf ek lamhe par tha, lekin yahan har lamhe zero hai. Is liye yahan speed hamesha ke liye constant hai, jaise topic ke Example 9 mein drone ki thi.

Tasdeeq
\[|\hat{\mathbf{v}}(\pi)|^{2} = \dfrac{0 + 1 + 4}{5} = 1\]
yani direction waqai unit vector hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\mathbf{v}(\pi) = 0\,\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 2\,\hat{k}\), \(\mathbf{a}(\pi) = \hat{i}\), speed \(= \sqrt{5} \approx 2.24\), direction \(\hat{\mathbf{v}} = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\hat{j} + \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\hat{k}\). Speed constant hai (\(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = 0\) har \(t\) par); acceleration \(z\)-axis ki taraf hai aur path us axis ke gird 1 radius ka helix hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 11.3 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain (Unit 11 ki kisi exercise ke jawab kitab mein nahin hain). Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) jaise angles radians mein hain, is liye calculator RAD mode mein rakhein. Apna hal yahan wale hal se mila kar dekhiye.
